attempts.text: [{"name": "id_rank_proximity_all", "idea": "Catalog-neighbourhood affinity: item ids are mapped to their rank among all items, then the rank distance from candidate j to the nearest item in the user's whole history and the number of history items within 10 ranks of j are computed, since adjacent ids often belong to the same product family or colour variants.", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH ir AS (SELECT item_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY item_id) AS r FROM (SELECT DISTINCT item_id FROM ev) x), h AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, item_id FROM ev WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users)), u AS (SELECT h.user_id, h.item_id, ir.r, 1 AS h FROM h JOIN ir ON ir.item_id = h.item_id UNION ALL SELECT c.user_id, c.item_id, ir.r, 0 AS h FROM cand c JOIN ir ON ir.item_id = c.item_id), w AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, r, h, SUM(h) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY r RANGE BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND 10 FOLLOWING) AS cnt, MAX(CASE WHEN h = 1 THEN r END) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY r, item_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS lo, MIN(CASE WHEN h = 1 THEN r END) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY r, item_id ROWS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS hi FROM u) SELECT user_id, item_id, LN(1 + LEAST(COALESCE(r - lo, 100000), COALESCE(hi - r, 100000))) AS ag_id_dist_all, CAST(cnt AS DOUBLE) AS ag_id_cnt10 FROM w WHERE h = 0;"}, {"name": "id_neighbourhood_trend", "idea": "Product-family demand: the log audience of the last 30 steps summed over the 10 items with adjacent id ranks (excluding j itself) and that neighbourhood's 7-to-30-step ratio, capturing family-level trends that a single item's counts miss.", "level": "item", "sql": "WITH it AS (SELECT item_id, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t >= {A} - 30 THEN user_id END) AS u30, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t >= {A} - 7 THEN user_id END) AS u7 FROM ev GROUP BY item_id), ir AS (SELECT item_id, u30, u7, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY item_id) AS r FROM it) SELECT a.item_id, LN(1 + SUM(b.u30)) AS ag_idnb_pop30, (SUM(b.u7) + 1.0) / (SUM(b.u30) + 1.0) AS ag_idnb_trend FROM ir a JOIN ir b ON b.r >= a.r - 5 AND b.r <= a.r + 5 AND b.r <> a.r GROUP BY a.item_id;"}, {"name": "recent_event_mean_age", "idea": "Within-window timing of demand: the mean age A - t of the item's events in the last 30 steps, a smooth indicator of whether its recent activity is concentrated near the anchor or fading.", "level": "item", "sql": "SELECT item_id, AVG(CAST({A} - t AS DOUBLE)) AS ag_rec_mean_age FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 30 GROUP BY item_id;"}, {"name": "id_rank_proximity_recent", "idea": "Recency-weighted catalog proximity: the sum over the user's last 20 items of 0.8^(position-1) times exp(-id-rank distance / 3) to candidate j, so variants of what the user just took score high.", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH ir AS (SELECT item_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY item_id) AS r FROM (SELECT DISTINCT item_id FROM ev) x), lu AS (SELECT user_id, item_id, rn FROM (SELECT user_id, item_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY t DESC, item_id) AS rn FROM ev WHERE user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM users)) x WHERE rn <= 20) SELECT c.user_id, c.item_id, SUM(POWER(0.8, lu.rn - 1) * EXP(-ABS(CAST(a.r AS DOUBLE) - b.r) / 3.0)) AS ag_id_prox_rec FROM cand c JOIN ir a ON a.item_id = c.item_id JOIN lu ON lu.user_id = c.user_id JOIN ir b ON b.item_id = lu.item_id GROUP BY 1, 2;"}, {"name": "audience_still_active", "idea": "Whether an item's community is still engaged: the share of its distinct adopters from [A-90, A-7) who are active in the last 7 steps, since items whose audience is currently active tend to keep spreading through co-adoption.", "level": "item", "sql": "WITH act AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 7), e AS (SELECT DISTINCT user_id, item_id FROM ev WHERE t >= {A} - 90 AND t < {A} - 7) SELECT e.item_id, AVG(CASE WHEN act.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS ag_aud_active7 FROM e LEFT JOIN act ON act.user_id = e.user_id GROUP BY e.item_id;"}]
